scope: Bind the canonical Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan Awoken Skill to the dated March 2018 Free Update using direct official release evidence.

records.basis: Bandai Namco Europe's 2018-03-01 release notice explicitly lists a new Awoken Skill, SSGSS Transformations, among the Free Update features.

boundary.limit_burst: The same official notice names Limit Burst as a new battle technique, but Limit Burst is represented as a battle-system/Super-Soul mechanic rather than a canonical skill record; no skill mapping is created for it.
boundary.event_date: 2018-03-01 is the official free-update release date and is retained as event provenance, not inferred as a game patch number.
boundary.source_of_truth: Canonical docs/data/skills.json remains authoritative; no verified/indexed projection overrides it.

next: Continue the provenance registry audit for older free-update/DLC skill cohorts where official sources explicitly name canonical skills; keep release dates separate from patch/version labels.
